These are estimates from my own prior knowledge of NAS-Bench-201 behavior, not computed from the benchmark data. The main priors I used:

- Removing or weakening an edge matters less when another path already carries the signal. It matters more when that edge is the main route from input to output.
- Conv edits matter less when the cell already has strong convs, since returns diminish.
- Most pairs show no consistent interaction across all three datasets, so N is the default.
